description: This source file implements the API for managing HDMI components within a TR-069 based device management system. It includes classes and methods for handling HDMI port instances, setting and getting HDMI resolution, enabling/disabling HDMI ports, and updating HDMI status information.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceHDMI
classes.description: Class representing an HDMI port instance, providing methods to get/set HDMI properties, handle messages, and perform updates.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceDisplayDevice
classes.description: Class managing display device details associated with HDMI port.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of HDMI port for a given device ID, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Returns a list of all existing HDMI port instances.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Removes and deletes a specified HDMI port instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Closes and deletes all HDMI port instances.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles setting HDMI port attributes based on message parameters.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles retrieving HDMI port attributes based on message parameters.

methods.name: doUpdates
methods.description: Performs updates on HDMI port properties and triggers callback if changes occur.

methods.name: setResolution
methods.description: Sets the HDMI resolution based on input string, parsing resolution details.

methods.name: getResolutionValue
methods.description: Retrieves current HDMI resolution as a string.

methods.name: setEnableVideoPort
methods.description: Enables or disables the HDMI port.

methods.name: getEnable
methods.description: Retrieves whether HDMI port is enabled.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the HDMI port ('Enabled' or 'Disabled').

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns human-readable name of the HDMI port.

methods.name: setHDMIResolutionMode
methods.description: Sets the resolution mode ('Auto' or 'Manual') for HDMI.
